title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression gating + CI eval metric integration
author: Marina Patel
release_notes: Add configurable prompt-set regression gating to eval-harness CI pipeline; integrate BLEU/ROUGE/ExactMatch thresholds and fail builds when regression detected; add docs and Linear tasks for threshold tuning.
description: Motivation: We need deterministic CI-level quality gates for prompt sets used in production to catch regressions early (ENG-1129). This PR adds a lightweight, configurable gating layer to the eval-harness that runs as part of our CI eval job. Summary: - Introduces an eval-gate module that compares current eval metrics against a baseline and configurable thresholds (relative and absolute). - Adds CI hooks to run the gating step after main evals in the nightly and PR pipelines; failures mark the job as failed and provide a summary artifact. - Integrates standard metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L, ExactMatch, and mean-token-likelihood) plus a normalized composite score. - Adds utilities to snapshot baseline metrics, update baselines via a protected endpoint/manual process, and store summarized diffs as artifacts in CI. - Includes unit and integration tests, small performance improvements to reduce eval runtime by ~8% (batching tweaks) and docs updates in eval-harness/README. Checklist: - [x] Adds eval-gate implementation and tests - [x] CI integration for PR and nightly pipelines - [x] Baseline snapshot tooling and docs - [x] Reviewer feedback addressed Testing & rollout: Unit tests cover gating logic and threshold parsing; integration test runs a few representative prompt-sets against a small model and asserts gating outcomes. Nightly pipeline will run the new gating logic as opt-in for the first week; after validating false-positive rates we will enable enforced gating on main. See linked Linear tasks for threshold tuning plan. Backwards compatibility: Default config is permissive (no-op) unless a repo-level gating config is provided, so existing repos are unaffected until opted in. Files changed (high level): eval-harness/eval_gate.py, ci/ci_eval_pipeline.yml, eval-harness/thresholds/defaults.yaml, eval-harness/tests/test_eval_gate.py, eval-harness/utils/baseline_store.py, docs/eval-harness.md, examples/prompt-sets/simple_smoke.json, examples/prompt-sets/README.md Commit summary: - 7f1a2d4 Add eval-gate module and baseline store - 9b2c5e1 Add threshold defaults and parsing - a3d4b9f Wire gating into CI eval pipeline and artifact upload - b12d8c3 Tests for gating logic and integration smoke - e33f7a0 Docs and examples for prompt-set gating Review notes: Initial review requested on 2026-02-18. Jared flagged threshold semantics (relative vs absolute) and suggested adding explicit provenance to baseline snapshots; addressed by adding metadata to baseline_store and unit tests. Sofia asked for clearer CI failure artifacts (summary json + human-readable table); added artifact generation and links in CI job output. Ravi asked for performance impact details; added micro-batching optimization to eval runner and included benchmark numbers in the PR description. CI checks: - linux-unit-tests: pass - pytype: pass - lint: pass - ci-eval-smoke: pass - nightly-eval: pass Merge: Squash and merge into main on 2026-03-01. Rationale for merging: Low-risk, configurable opt-in gate that provides high signal for prompt regressions and improved CI visibility. Post-merge actions: - Create Linear task to run threshold calibration across critical prompt-sets (ENG-1142) - Enable gating opt-in on a subset of repos for one week and review false positives - Add dashboard in Console for gating failures (follow-up PR planned)

diff_snippets:
--- eval-harness/eval_gate.py
+def check_against_baseline(current, baseline, thresholds):
+    # compute metric diffs and apply thresholds
+    diffs = {}
+    for k in thresholds:
+        diffs[k] = current.get(k, 0) - baseline.get(k, 0)
+    return diffs

--- ci/ci_eval_pipeline.yml
+      - name: Run eval-harness gating
+        uses: ./eval-harness/action-runner@v1
+        with:
+          run-gate: true
+          gate-config: eval-harness/thresholds/defaults.yaml
